meta.title: Mid-year population estimates by age (local authority)
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics; mid-2022 onward rolled forward from Census 2021 using admin data. International migration component is the largest source of uncertainty and is revised as ONS improves admin-based migration estimates.
meta.limitations: Point estimates with no published confidence intervals. Student-age (18-24) counts depend on term-time address rules (students counted at term-time address). Earlier years may be revised. 16-19 and 25-64 are sums of published single-year/band counts.
